art_note: The flat product shots are clean, but the model shots and composite angles look generic and marketplace-style, undermining the luxury positioning.
desc_en: A refined silhouette defines this short dress featuring adjustable thin straps. The monochrome contrast of roses and foliage against a light backdrop exudes understated sophistication. Designed for a light and fluid drape, this piece transitions seamlessly from evening dinners to summer gatherings. Each garment is made to order to ensure absolute exclusivity. Available with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una silueta depurada define este vestido corto con tirantes finos ajustables. El contraste monocromático de rosas y follaje sobre fondo claro aporta un aire sofisticado. Diseñado para ofrecer una caída ligera y fluida, este modelo se adapta con naturalidad a veladas nocturnas y eventos estivales. Cada pieza se confecciona bajo demanda para garantizar una exclusividad absoluta. Disponible con envío a todo el mundo.
